lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
Batch size: per release. Equipment: QC laboratory, XRF-01, SC-2B.
1. Viscosity: Ford cup No. 4 (AF-12) or Brookfield (EF-210, TL-5) against product
2. Fineness of grind (Hegman gauge) on AF-12 and EF-210.
3. Chloride content of every AF-12 batch (limit 400 ppm).
4. XRF lead screening of every incoming pigment lot.
5. Retain a 0.5 L sample of every batch for 5 years.
6. Re-weigh every pigment addition on bench scale SC-2B and countersign.
8. Odour check of every batch by the QC technician.
Controlled copy - the MES recipe is the master.
